# PDF.js

OriginRAG ships unmodified display/worker builds, viewer CSS, character maps,
fonts, ICC profiles and WebAssembly codecs from Mozilla PDF.js 6.3.289.
Only the PDF renderer is used. The reader interface and personal notes are
implemented separately by OriginRAG.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.3.289.tgz
Distribution integrity (SHA-512, base64):
`ZHjSVpDa3D6izMq8/04lvkhkATUmL9px6ChPaXc1k6nU2Mrhlg1/7F0bdUqCwUjw3NsPTfPZsMDUU6ZIcRaeQw==`

PDF.js is Apache-2.0 licensed, see LICENSE. Fonts and codecs retain their
additional licence files in their respective subdirectories. These licences
are separate from OriginRAG's MIT licence. All assets are served locally.
